column1: # WHERE THE FLEET PINS ITS HOST IMAGE. One row per pinned image variable.
# Read by scripts/ci/runner-version-watch.sh, daily, to answer the question the
# 2026-11-05 outage turned on: which runner version is each pool ACTUALLY
# booting? This repository's own pin can be current while every pool still
# boots an older image. A pool pins an exact image name in its root's tfvars,
# never a family. The name `ci-runner-host-g<sha>` (or `-vX-Y-Z`) names the
# ci-runner-infra commit that built it, and the runner version is read from that
#   repo      repository under this repository's owner that holds the root
#   branch    its default branch (not always main, see fleet/repos.tsv)
#   variable  the variable holding the Linux image (Windows images carry a
#             contract version, not a build ref, so they are not listed here)
# The legacy per-repository roots (Atlas, Specaria-Platform's own ci-runners)
# were folded into these two shared roots and are not listed. Add a row
# when a new root pins a host image.
